definitions.short: a narrow place , i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability
definitions.full: H4689. matsoq מָצוֺק noun [masculine] straitness, straits, stress ; — always absolute ׳מ ; — מ ׳כָּלאִֿישׁ 1Sam 22:2 every man of straits (in straits); וּבְמ ׳בְּמָצוֺר Deut 28:53 , 55 , 57 ; Jer 19:9 (all of national straits ); ׳צַרוּֿמ מְצָאוּנִי Psa 119:143 ; perhaps read מָצוֺק also 32:6 , for רק מצא , compare Du Br.
